evidence_context.title: Light-Time-Biomass Response Model for Predicting the Growth of Choy Sum (Brassica rapa var. parachinensis) in Soil-Based LED-Constructed Indoor Plant Factory for Efficient Seedling Production
evidence_context.finding: Models light, time and seedling biomass.
evidence_context.scope: Singapore-affiliated; soil-based indoor LED; experiment details still require extraction
evidence_context.limit: Seedling biomass is not mature marketable yield; extract stage and fresh/dry-weight definitions before parameterization.

evidence_context.title: Widely-targeted metabolomics and transcriptomics identify metabolites associated with flowering regulation of Choy Sum
evidence_context.finding: Investigates flowering-related physiology and molecular signals.
evidence_context.scope: China; precise experimental site requires verification; flowering study
evidence_context.limit: Omics associations are not a validated days-to-harvest model.

evidence_context.title: Optimal Plant Density, Nutrient Concentration and Rootzone Temperature for Higher Growth and Yield of Brassica rapa L. Curly Dwarf Pak Choy in Raft Hydroponic System Under Tropical Climate
evidence_context.finding: Tests density, solution conductivity and root-zone temperature jointly.
evidence_context.limit: The best tested treatment is not a universal recipe; DOI was not established.

evidence_context.title: Extended photoperiod improves growth and nutritional quality of pak choi under constant daily light integral
evidence_context.finding: Three cultivars were compared across photoperiod and light-intensity treatments; final harvest was 32 days after sowing in that experiment.
evidence_context.scope: Netherlands; SFA co-author and funding; controlled-environment hydroponics
evidence_context.limit: Constant DLI does not imply identical growth; the Zenodo deposit is described as LC-MS data, not necessarily a complete yield time series.

evidence_context.title: Microclimate control to increase productivity and nutritional quality of leafy vegetables in a cost-effective manner
evidence_context.finding: Discusses root-zone management and supplementary lighting in tropical production.
evidence_context.limit: Research overview; cited experiments must not be counted again as independent observations.

evidence_context.title: Nitrate accumulation, productivity and photosynthesis of Brassica alboglabra grown under low light with supplemental LED lighting in the tropical greenhouse
evidence_context.finding: Examines light, productivity and nitrate accumulation.
evidence_context.scope: Singapore; tropical greenhouse with supplementary LEDs
evidence_context.limit: No universal nitrogen, nitrate-limit or LED prescription is inferred.

evidence_context.title: Reduced nitrogen availability in hydroponically grown Chinese broccoli does not affect photosynthetic performance and yield while enhancing nitrogen use efficiency and nutritional quality
evidence_context.finding: Studies reduced nitrogen within a defined experimental treatment range.
evidence_context.scope: Singapore-affiliated; precise site to extract; hydroponics
evidence_context.limit: The year is 2026 despite a 2025 DOI suffix; this does not authorize autonomous fertilizer changes.

evidence_context.title: Controlling root zone temperature improves plant growth and pigments in hydroponic lettuce
evidence_context.finding: Root-zone temperature affects biomass and pigments under tested conditions.
evidence_context.limit: Performance remains conditional on cultivar, ambient conditions and experimental scale.

evidence_context.title: Raising root zone temperature improves plant productivity and metabolites in hydroponic lettuce production
evidence_context.finding: Root warming can help in its tested environmental context.
evidence_context.limit: Cooling and warming studies are not contradictory when baselines differ; there is no one fixed optimum.

evidence_context.title: Using Machine Learning Models to Predict Hydroponically Grown Lettuce Yield
evidence_context.finding: Compares ML methods using plant measurements recorded at harvest.
evidence_context.scope: Egypt; greenhouse hydroponic and aeroponic systems
evidence_context.limit: Harvest-time dry weight and contemporaneous measurements cannot be used in an earlier planting-date forecast.

evidence_context.title: Lettuce Production in Intelligent Greenhouses—3D Imaging and Computer Vision for Plant Spacing Decisions
evidence_context.finding: Links crop imaging to spacing decisions; companion experimental data exists.
evidence_context.limit: External greenhouse data is not a representative Singapore farm-demand dataset.

evidence_context.title: Limitations to photosynthesis of lettuce grown under tropical conditions: alleviation by root-zone cooling
evidence_context.finding: Contrasts cooled roots with fluctuating warm root-zone conditions.
evidence_context.scope: Singapore; tropical cultivation with root-zone treatments
evidence_context.limit: Older physiological experiment; not an energy-price or commercial yield forecast.

evidence_context.title: Enhancing Productivity and Improving Nutritional Quality of Subtropical and Temperate Leafy Vegetables in Tropical Greenhouses and Indoor Farming Systems
evidence_context.scope: Singapore-focused synthesis; protected and indoor systems
evidence_context.limit: A review is not another independent experimental dataset.

messages.content: Convene the council on this frozen experiment. Compare Lean, Balanced, and Resilient consequences, retain evidence-backed disagreements, and let Asha conclude.

messages.speaker: advisor
messages.content: Booked demand is identical across policies, yet scenario booked deliveries fall in every policy versus baseline, so the delay leaves booked orders short. Limit: these are synthetic policy comparisons, not observed outcomes.

messages.speaker: advisor
messages.content: No frozen public weather observation is supplied for this experiment, so I cannot assess conditions or their uncertainty. Any comparison across the policies would exceed that evidence limit; abstaining.

messages.speaker: advisor
messages.content: No connected frozen community-market observation is available, so market consequences cannot be assessed. This abstains for lack of that source, not from evidence of no effect.

messages.speaker: advisor
messages.content: The delay leaves the delayed batch's harvest unsold in the near-term order across policies, while later orders stay met in most policies. Limits: these are synthetic scenario-minus-baseline deltas, not observed outcomes. Relevant metrics are fill rate and harvest weight.

messages.speaker: advisor
messages.content: Delivery timing is the binding issue: the delayed batch's near-term booked line drops to zero delivered in all policies, while later dated lines remain filled in most policies. This is a synthetic comparison, not an observed outcome.

messages.content: Cost and margin effects differ by policy: Lean shows a small margin gain versus both Balanced and Resilient, which each show margin losses. Limit: these are synthetic scenario-minus-baseline deltas, not observed outcomes.

messages.content: Across policies, scenario fill rates sit below their baselines and shortfalls rise, with Resilient highest and Lean lowest. Margins fall under all policies, though Lean's decline is smallest. These are synthetic deltas, not observed effects.
